title: Feature Locked - Customer Believes It's Included
scenario_context: Customer on Starter plan; Export feature is Pro+. Must explain entitlement clearly, offer workaround first, then optional upgrade. Avoid blame or pressure.
success_summary: Expectation setting with workaround-first and non-pushy upgrade option.

customer_profile.name: Riya Mehra
customer_profile.opening_message: Why is the Export button locked? I paid for this.
customer_profile.secret_condition: Customer accepts if agent offers an immediate workaround and explains entitlement clearly without blame
customer_profile.personality_notes: Urgent and slightly accusatory, but cooperative if helped quickly.

checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Lead with empathy before policy/plan details.

checkpoints.description: Verify plan tier and confirm Export entitlement
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Confirm Starter vs Pro before explaining.

checkpoints.description: Explain entitlement in soft language (no blame)
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Avoid phrasing like 'you should have known'.

checkpoints.description: Offer an immediate workaround based on their export need
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Ask what format they need and propose a workaround.

checkpoints.description: Offer upgrade as an option (trial/upgrade) without pressure; offer note review if promised
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Present upgrade calmly; offer to check notes if they claim it was promised.
